errors.evidence: The chart title explicitly states '(възможен е повече от един отговор)', which means '(more than one answer is possible)'. The machine-generated description incorrectly states the responses are from a single answer.
The categories are not listed on the horizontal axis. They are listed vertically on the left side of the chart, functioning as a legend.
The categories are not listed in alphabetical order. For example, 'Дизайнът е бизнес стратегия' is followed by 'Дизайнът е стандартизиран ма...', which is not alphabetical.
